name: manual_b1828d
claim: code-review-graph (CRG) MCP server must be configured in both project-level .mcp.json AND global ~/.claude.json to work from Claude Code. CRG runs via uvx code-review-graph serve, not as a standalone binary. The env vars (PYTHON, CRG_OPENAI_API_KEY=ollama, CRG_OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434/v1, CRG_OPENAI_MODEL=bge-m3, CRG_OPENAI_DIMENSION=1024, CRG_ACCEPT_CLOUD_EGRESS=1) must match exactly in both configs.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-14: CRG was configured in OpenClaw/.mcp.json and .codex/mcp.json but missing from ~/.claude.json, so Claude Code could not reach it globally. Fixed by copying the same uvx env block.
